items.summary: Biocon announced a settlement with Genentech over its biosimilar, Pebrilzo, of the cancer drug Perjeta. The agreement allows Biocon to launch Pebrilzo in early 2027 in the UK and EU, and in late 2028 in the US. In response to Genentech's patent infringement suit, the New Jersey court dismissed the case at Genentech's request. The details of the settlement agreement remain confidential between the companies involved.

items.summary: Canara Bank experienced an 8.4% year-on-year increase in net profit, reaching ₹5,175 crore for Q2 FY27. The bank's improvement in asset quality contributed to this profit growth, alongside core income expansion. However, mark-to-market losses from rising bond yields limited higher earnings outcomes. Its gross non-performing assets ratio also improved, declining to 1.3% from both the previous quarter and last year.
